step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify all entities shown on the whiteboard: Traffic DB (ThirdParty), DynamoDB, RDS, Redshift (Source), Elastic Search (OpenSearch), DW On-Prem (OnPremDC), Data Lake (S3), Glue, S3, Redshift Target (RedShift), and BI EC2 (EC2).
2. Create corresponding nodes with exact allowable vocabulary services.
3. Map connections: 5 data sources on the left point into DATALAKE. DW ON-PREM and S3 feed into GLUE. GLUE has a bidirectional relationship with DATALAKE and REDSHIFT Target. REDSHIFT Target outputs to BI EC2.
4. Formulate flows: Flow 0 for raw data ingestion into Data Lake, Flow 1 for ETL processing via Glue, target warehouse loading into Redshift Spectrum, and serving BI queries on EC2.

graph.name: Lotte ON BI Platform Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture of Lotte ON BI platform collecting structured and unstructured data across multiple sources, processing via AWS Glue and Redshift Spectrum, and serving analytical insights via BI EC2.

nodes.name: TRAFFIC DB
nodes.notes: On-premises or external database storing traffic logs in Avro format.

nodes.name: DYNAMODB
nodes.notes: AWS DynamoDB storing nested operational data.

nodes.name: RDS
nodes.notes: AWS Relational Database Service used as a transactional data source.

nodes.name: REDSHIFT (Source)
nodes.notes: Source Redshift cluster providing source analytics data.

nodes.name: ELASTIC SEARCH
nodes.notes: Elasticsearch cluster storing search logs and unstructured data.

nodes.name: DW ON-PREM
nodes.notes: On-premises enterprise data warehouse ingested directly into Glue.

nodes.name: DATALAKE
nodes.notes: Central S3 Data Lake storing raw, intermediate Avro, and converted Parquet files.

nodes.name: GLUE
nodes.notes: AWS Glue utilizing Spark and Python shell jobs for ETL transformations.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Auxiliary S3 storage bucket supporting Glue ETL pipelines.

nodes.name: REDSHIFT (Target)
nodes.notes: Target Redshift warehouse using Redshift Spectrum and stored procedures.

nodes.name: BI EC2
nodes.notes: EC2 instance hosting BI reporting tool providing insights to web/mobile users.

edges.notes: Traffic DB streams data to DATALAKE.
DynamoDB operational data ingested into DATALAKE.
Source Redshift data ingested into DATALAKE.
On-prem DW data directly ingested by Glue.
Glue accesses auxiliary S3 storage resources.
Glue reads raw data from DATALAKE.
Glue writes processed Parquet files back to DATALAKE.
Glue pushes transformed data into target Redshift warehouse.
Redshift interacts bi-directionally with Glue metastore/ETL.
Target Redshift serves processed data to BI EC2 instance.
